claim: Which damage breaks a breakable thing is fixed by its type: a wall crack (408) and an explode object (417) take only explosive damage (417 also tesla); a gib object (416) also takes bullets and falls. A blast-only floor cover, such as a manhole, is a type 417.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/actor.cpp:1819 Wall Crack, :1947 Gib Object, :1963 Explode Object: the damage-shift rows 0,0,0,256,0,0,0 / 256,0,256,256,0,0,128 / 0,0,0,256,0,0,128
E4M3 sprite 130: type 417, tile 191, cstat 417, repeat 48, data_1 5, data_4 314, a flat cover over a link floor
use: Choose 416 when anything should break it, 417 for blast only, 408 for a crack that only a charge opens.
